io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories

Class AddonSectionItemGroup

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.ItemGroup
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories.AddonSectionItemGroup
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Keyed

    public class AddonSectionItemGroup
extends ItemGroup
    One addon's slice of a guide category in the categorized layout: the "<Addon> <Type>" tile.

    Carries which addon and category it represents so the guide can draw that addon's info widgets on its bottom row. The tile is otherwise a plain ItemGroup holding the addon's items of that type.
